thread:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock the playbook scope for batching/caching/quant recs + eval-triggered alerts before Monday's roadmap review. Thinking 2-phase launch (advisor -> ops) and a small pilot list.
priya: +1. Can we define concrete launch gates? engineers need clear pass/fail so they can stop rework.
mike: Agree. My ask: batch/caching recs must not push p95 latency above current by >5% under typical qps. Otherwise we won't enable by default.
sam: Also quant recs need a fallback path. If a customer sees quality regressions we must auto-fallback and capture prompt/eval context.
leo: Proposal draft in thread: Phase 1 = "Read-only Advisor" (API + console recs, non-blocking). Phase 2 = "Ops Integration" (auto-suggest + pilot toggles + eval-alerts). Pilot run = 3 customers.
jenna: For pilots I can start outreach to two existing beta customers that have long-tail contexts. Suggest: acme-health and scribble-ai? (they already trialed adaptive batching).
priya: need acceptance metrics. Suggest:
- Perf: p95 latency change <= +5% and p99 <= +10% vs baseline
- Cost: token/unit cost <= 0.95x baseline when recommended profile applied
- Quality: eval concordance >= 0.88 on customer prompt-set (no more than 2% drop in utility)
- Reliability: auto-fallback executes <500ms after detection
mike: Those look reasonable. Add operational checks: rollout controls, per-tenant opt-out, and visibility (trace + reason for recommendation).
sam: How will eval-triggered alerts work? We need rule types: regressions vs distribution shift. Example: if concordance drops below threshold for X% of prompts in last Y minutes -> alert.
anya: Yes — two triggers: (1) regression alert (hard fail) when concordance < threshold for >= 5% of eval-set over 1h; (2) drift warning when token distribution shifts beyond baseline (informational).
leo: Milestones:
- Spec finalization (this week)
- Eng prototype (2 sprints)
- Pilot enablement + customer onboarding (sprint 3)
- Post-pilot decision (launch vs iterate)
jenna: Who owns the pilot runbook? I can drive onboarding and org-level comms if eng provides checklist.
mike: I'll own runtime + fallback. Need a short API contract for recommendations:
{"model_variant": "text-xxx-quantized-8bit", "expected_latencies": { "p50": 20, "p95": 120 }, "confidence_score": 0.92, "reason": "prefix-cache-hit -> batching safe"}
priya: Nice. Add `concordance_estimate` and `eval_snapshot_id` so we can tie rec to eval.
sam: For eval alerts, define retention: keep per-eval aggregate for 90d, raw prompt samples 30d unless customer opts out. GDPR/compliance concerns?
leo: We'll route privacy questions to security & compliance. For default, redact user PII from stored samples.
anya: Risk list:
- Quality regressions on certain edge prompt families
- Latency regressions under heavy tail workloads
- Cost-savings promise mismatch (customers expect bigger savings)
We should map mitigations.
jenna: Mitigations: small canary cohorts, clear expectations in onboarding, automated rollback. Also add a "show me the test prompts" UI in console.
priya: Decision needed: do we allow recommendations to be applied automatically in Phase 2, or is human confirmation required? Ops prefers manual for first 6 weeks.
mike: Strong +1 to manual. Auto-apply later if success metrics stable for 30 days.
leo: Agreed. We'll include an opt-in auto-apply checkbox and require SRE signoff for full auto rollout.
anya: Action items:
- priya: finalize acceptance metric wording and produce a one-pager (today)
- mike: spec runtime API + fallback contract (EOD Fri)
- jenna: coordinate pilot invites, draft consent language (Mon)
- sam: draft eval-trigger taxonomy + alert SLA doc (Mon)
- leo: consolidate into a short roadmap slide for Monday review
deploy-bot: Deployed message: playbook-spec-v0.3 pushed to /docs/playbooks/inference-recs (jenna).
jenna: Linking initial spec: https://go.redwood/internal/playbooks/inference-recs (feedback welcome) :heart:
priya: Thanks team. If we can get the one-pager and API contract this week we can still keep the current roadmap milestone.
mike: I'll slot runtime work into sprint 18 and add a CI test for fallback behavior.
anya: Great — closing thread. If anything else, DM.
